attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Three head names on one page, so three folders**, which is `docs/CORPUS.md` §10.1; the page carries «Αγιος Παμφαμηρ», «Αγιος Παμφυλων» and «Αγιος Σολοχων» as three head entries, and prints two couplets, one for Solochon alone and one for the other two together. **Nothing in the corpus reads as him**: the namesweep printed no row for the name. **No year, so no `dates` object**: the page gives only Maximian's reign, 286–305. **The page's illustration caption offers a second form of his name**, «Άγιος Σόλων (Σολόχων)», which is recorded in the life and not copied as a name form, a caption being not the entry. **The tribune Campanus and the widow in whose house he died have no folders.** **No `locations` object**, although Egypt and Chalcedon are named.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
